description: User-ID check accepts a trailing newline: _ASCII_DIGITS_RE '^[0-9]+$' with .match lets '7\n' through as user 7 (criterion 9); same for permission_fingerprint and application_commit.

RefusalRedactingRunner logs a WARNING for every non-RuleSetRefusal refusal, but the inner guards already log WARNING on their fail-closed paths, so those refusals write two WARNING records (criterion 26).
redacted_refusal_text falls back to the read-only or RLS text for an unrecognised refusal message, giving the model the wrong kind of refusal.
config-loading.md list of sub-sections setting extra='forbid' omits RuleSetsConfig.
mysql_connect_kwargs docstring does not mention the ValueError raised for a URL with no user/host or a non-numeric port.
RuleSetsConfig can hold file set with loaded None; consumers read that as no rule sets (fails open), though no shipped path reaches it.
Lists inside frozen records are mutable, LoadedRuleSets is a mutable dataclass, CatalogConfirmation.confirmed can be set without its lock.
RuleSetRefusal.kind is a free str placed into client text; TableRule.row_rule is typed Any.
_url_database strips one leading '/' while build_sql_runner uses lstrip('/'), so a '//' path compares a different database name.
No test drives a rule-set refusal through the MCP query_database tool in server.py.
Preflight branch for a failed information_schema read (non-RuleSetCatalogError) is untested.
